spec.description: SMSEagle device health, messaging statistics, modem signal, and service status — collected via Grafana Alloy.

spec.title: Total Messages Sent
spec.description: Cumulative messages sent across all channels.

spec.title: Modem Signal Strength
spec.description: Cellular signal strength per modem. Low values (<10) indicate poor connectivity.

spec.title: Signal Strength (Current)
spec.description: Current signal strength per modem (0–100%).

spec.title: Modem Enabled
spec.description: Modem enabled state. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled.

spec.title: Network Registration
spec.description: Network registration status per modem.

spec.title: SIM Status
spec.description: SIM card status per modem. 0 = missing/error, 1 = OK.

spec.title: Service Status
spec.description: Enabled/disabled state of each SMSEagle service (data_conn, email2sms, mqtt, snmp, etc.).

spec.title: Support Contract
spec.description: Whether support contract is active. Shows expiry date as label.

spec.title: Firmware Update
spec.description: 1 = firmware update is available. Check the version label for the new version.

spec.title: SMPP Enabled
spec.description: SMPP service enabled flag.

spec.title: SMPP Core
spec.description: SMPP core subsystem status.

spec.title: Total Messages Delivered
spec.description: Cumulative messages successfully delivered.

spec.title: SMPP SMS
spec.description: SMPP SMS processing subsystem status.

spec.title: SMPP SQL
spec.description: SMPP SQL backend subsystem status.

spec.title: Temperature over Time
spec.description: Temperature readings over time per sensor.

spec.title: Current Temperature
spec.description: Current temperature reading per sensor.

spec.title: Sensor Enabled
spec.description: Whether the temperature sensor is enabled.

spec.title: Sensor Status
spec.description: Temperature sensor operational status reported by SMSEagle.

spec.title: Total Message Errors
spec.description: Cumulative message send/delivery failures. High values indicate channel issues.

spec.title: SMPP Connection
spec.description: SMPP connection state. 0 = disconnected, 1 = connected.

spec.title: HA Failover State
spec.description: 1 = OK (HA disabled or master). 0 = backup/fault — needs attention.

spec.title: Messages Sent by Channel
spec.description: Rate of messages sent per channel over time.

spec.title: Message Errors by Channel
spec.description: Rate of message errors per channel. Spikes indicate delivery failures.

spec.title: Inbox Messages by Channel
spec.description: Messages currently queued in the inbox per channel.

spec.title: Outbox Queue by Channel
spec.description: Messages waiting in the outbox queue per channel. High values may indicate congestion.

spec.title: SMSEagle Monitoring
